title: Design System: Generative AI and Algorithmic Manipulation

display.purpose: The conference title in the hero only.

headline.purpose: Section headings; they match the navigation labels.

subhead.purpose: Speaker names, day dates, abstract titles, venue blocks.

figure.purpose: Fact values, hero date, about subjects, keynote titles.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: State transitions on actions and links, 160 ms.

motion.name: pull-field
motion.value: continuous Canvas 2D simulation, 60 fps, paused when hidden
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: trails bent by hidden drifting attractors. Reduced motion and Save-Data: one settled still frame. Scroll does not drive it.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Biography disclosure icon rotation; none under reduced motion.

components.name: Text on the Field
components.description: Section text directly on the Pull Field. A soft local wash appears behind a block only when the contrast guard finds very poor contrast.
components.html:
About

components.css: .ds-field { padding: 3rem 1.5rem; background: #f1f5f8; color: #082246; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.6 'Familjen Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field h2 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font: 400 2.25rem/1.02 'Hedvig Letters Serif', Georgia, serif; } .ds-field-washed { position: relative; isolation: isolate; } .ds-field-washed::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -0.6em -1em; z-index: -1; background: #f1f5f8; filter: blur(18px); opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Navigation Link (active)

narrative.overview: Behind the whole page, sparse, soft Swedish-blue trails fall across a plaster ground and bend around hidden, drifting attractors that are never drawn: influence seen only in its effects. Content sits directly on the field; only the header keeps a glass bar and the programme a night field. A contrast guard adds a soft local wash only where text would be hard to read.
keyCharacteristics: Page-wide Canvas 2D field of trails bent by hidden attractors
Text directly on the field; local wash only where contrast is poor
Plaster ground, Swedish-blue trails, night programme field
Hedvig Letters Serif speaks, Familjen Grotesk informs
Square corners, hairlines, no drop shadows, no cards

rules.name: The One Point Rule
rules.body: Vantage Red marks the section in view, as a navigation dot, and nothing else; the attractors are never drawn.

rules.name: The Surface Scope Rule
rules.body: Sections set their surface with one class that redefines semantic tokens; components use semantic tokens only.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No uppercase kickers and no section numbers; headings match navigation labels.

rules.name: The 16px Root Rule
rules.body: Never set a font size on html; every rem means 16px.

rules.name: The Surface Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Interface elevation comes from surface change, never from shadow.

rules.name: The Contrast Guard Rule
rules.body: Text sits directly on the field. A soft plaster or night wash appears behind a text block only when its 10th-percentile contrast is very poor (under 3.5:1 small, 2.5:1 large) or a busy patch sits behind small text.

dos: Do keep the field light and sparse enough that text rarely needs a wash.
Do keep the attractors clear of the hero and footer text.
Do use tabular figures for every time.
Do show unfinished programme items as To be announced, in muted text.
Do check text over the field in every section on desktop and phone.
donts: Don't use Vantage Red for anything except the navigation dot.
Don't add section backgrounds other than the programme field, cards, drop shadows or rounded corners.
Don't animate sections on entry, hijack scrolling, or change colours with scroll.
Don't raise trail count or contrast without re-checking every section.
